en.headline: Police investigate criminal damage after red liquid thrown in Tsuen Wan claw machine shop
en.dek: Two black-clad men entered a claw machine shop on Hoi On Street early on Tuesday and splashed red liquid on machines, the floor and walls before fleeing, police said.
body: Police are investigating a case of criminal damage after two men in black clothing threw red liquid inside a claw machine shop on Hoi On Street in Tsuen Wan early on Tuesday.

The shop operator reported the incident at about 6:52am. Officers found red stains on multiple claw machines, the floor and other fixtures. CCTV footage showed one man pouring the liquid from bottles while another filmed or kept watch outside; the pair left within about one minute.

The operator, surnamed Chu, told media the shop had no disputes or protection-fee issues and suspected the act might be related to competition, as the outlet focuses on soft toys. No arrests have been made.
Police classified the case as criminal damage and are seeking the two suspects.

zh.headline: 荃灣夾公仔店遭淋紅色液體 警方列刑事毀壞跟進
zh.dek: 周二凌晨兩名黑衣男子進入享和街夾公仔店，向機台、地面及牆壁淋潑紅色液體後逃去，警方正在調查。
body: 警方正調查一宗刑事毀壞案件，周二凌晨兩名黑衣男子在荃灣享和街一間夾公仔店內淋潑紅色液體。
店舖負責人約早上6時52分報案。警方到場發現多部夾公仔機、地面及其他設施沾有紅色液體。閉路電視顯示一名男子用樽裝液體淋潑，另一人在外拍攝或把風，兩人約一分鐘內離開。
姓朱負責人向傳媒表示，店舖並無結怨或保護費問題，懷疑可能涉及競爭，店舖主要售賣公仔。目前仍未有人被捕。
警方將案件列作刑事毀壞，正追緝兩名涉案男子。
